scope_policy: Evidence is per selected operation. Normal restart, abrupt process termination, and measured resource campaigns are separate gates. No provider-wide support promotion. Exact operation_ids join every selected SDK scope to matrix candidates; operation_id_aliases retain display-name mappings, and operation_id_checks restrict assertion categories per method/variant. Candidate links remain unproven until matching eligible evidence is reviewed; authentication modes are independent.
